title: Split cloud target discovery from status filtering
summary: Cloud workflow target selection can fail before the mutation step when a provider rejects a combined stable-identity filter plus online/status filter; split discovery, local status filtering, and diagnostics.
ai_value: Helps deployment agents fail closed on zero or multiple online targets while preserving pre-mutation diagnostics instead of losing evidence before artifact upload.

contexts: CI/CD or deployment workflow opens a remote management session
target selection combines stable identity such as tags/names with dynamic status such as online/reachable
failure before remote execution can bypass the normal artifact-upload path

tools.name: cloud provider management API
observed_versions: AWS Systems Manager DescribeInstanceInformation tag filter plus PingStatus worked example

trigger_signals.description: Instance or node lookup fails before any remote command/session starts.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Capture diagnostics before the mutation-capable stage.

trigger_signals.description: Provider error mentions invalid or unsupported filter combinations rather than no matching target.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Suspect API filter-contract mismatch instead of missing infrastructure.

trigger_signals.description: The same target is visible when filtering by stable identity alone.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Use a two-stage selection: provider query by stable identity, local filter by status.

trigger_signals.description: Normal deploy/apply artifact is missing because failure occurred before the later artifact step.
trigger_signals.agent_interpretation: Move diagnostic capture earlier than mutation.

negative_signals.description: The provider explicitly documents that the exact identity+status filter combination is supported for the API version in use.
negative_signals.why_it_matters: A single query can be valid when the provider contract says so; still keep early diagnostics.

negative_signals.description: The operation is a read-only inventory with no later mutation-capable step.
negative_signals.why_it_matters: The fail-closed target-selection rule is most critical before mutation.

common_wrong_assumptions: If a cloud console shows the target, the combined CLI/API filter must be valid.
Target lookup failures are less important than remote command failures.
Zero results and unsupported filters should be handled the same way.

first_checks.check: Query by stable identity first, then locally filter for online/reachable status.
first_checks.why: Stable identity and dynamic liveness often have different provider filter semantics.

first_checks.check: Fail closed when zero or multiple online targets remain.
first_checks.why: Remote mutation should not proceed against an absent or ambiguous target.

first_checks.check: Upload or persist lookup diagnostics before any mutation-capable step.
first_checks.why: Early failures otherwise leave no evidence for the next agent.

first_checks.check: For AWS Systems Manager, check DescribeInstanceInformation filter constraints before combining tag filters with PingStatus.
first_checks.why: AWS documents that tag filters cannot be combined with other filter types for this API.

decision_rules.condition: Provider docs or errors say stable-identity filters cannot be combined with status filters.
decision_rules.then: Query by stable identity, local-filter for online/reachable state, and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.

decision_rules.condition: Target lookup can fail before the normal artifact-upload step.
decision_rules.then: Persist selected target candidates, filter result, and provider error before opening a remote session or running mutations.

do_not: Do not broaden remote-command scope to compensate for a failed lookup.
Do not ignore zero or multiple online targets.
Do not put diagnostics only after the mutation step.

Do not include private service names, internal URLs, account identifiers, incident identifiers, private repository paths, tenant/store names, setup-card field names, low-level endpoint strings or organization-specific tooling in public lessons.

agent_directives.preferred_next_step: Run stable-identity discovery, local status filtering, fail-closed cardinality checks, and early diagnostic capture before remote mutation.

risk.notes: This public record is de-identified and does not authorize live mutation, publication, credential, permission, billing, data, or availability changes by itself.
